steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Smart Install valve tests
steps.body: Enter Smart Install manual check. Steps Co (cold) and Ho (hot) exercise inlet valves. Drum must be empty.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Smart Install manual check. Steps Co (cold) and Ho (hot) exercise inlet valves. Drum must be empty.

steps.title: Continue to manual check
steps.body: Smart Install active. Continue below for component-specific checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual check mode steps Co/Ho/Spin per §4-2.

steps.title: Valves operate in manual check
steps.body: Do cold and hot valves open and fill when commanded in manual check?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Do cold and hot valves open and fill when commanded in manual check?

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Verify taps open, screens clean, harness to valves; replace valve assembly.

steps.title: Check water supply
steps.oemOutcome: Open taps, clean mesh filters, verify pressure and hose routing.

steps.title: Inlet valves OK
steps.oemOutcome: Valves operate in Smart Install — supply and harness verified.
